# Vendored terminal font

The authenticated Remote Shell serves this font locally so Powerline,
Starship, tmux, and Nerd Font symbols render consistently on desktop and
mobile browsers without a CDN or a device-level font installation.

- Font: FiraCode Nerd Font Mono Regular
- Fira Code version: 6.002
- Nerd Fonts version: 3.3.0
- Upstream: <https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts>
- Web format: WOFF2 converted from the locally installed TTF without changing
  its glyph set
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see `OFL.txt`
